title: A wallet holds a credential. It does not decide which root issued it.
post:
Europe is building wallets. Every member state owes its citizens one, and the engineering is well under way.

The question underneath the programme is quieter. A wallet holds credentials; it does not establish which root a company credential chains to.

What we do not claim: nothing in this post asserts a deployed Acme capability.
teaser_linkedin:
A wallet holds a credential. It does not decide which root issued it.

The wallet programme is engineering. The root is governance, and it is still open.

title: A closed set answers who may transact by exclusion. Identity answers it by proof.
post:
A settlement set between vetted parties is a closed set. Membership is the product; the ledger is the plumbing.

What we do not claim: the set named here has no members beyond those on its published list.

title: An answerable record names who acted. An auditable one only shows that someone did.
post:
Audit trails show that something happened. Accountability asks who is answerable for it, and that is a property of the record's design.

What we do not claim: no regulator named here has adopted the distinction in a rule.

Accountability is a design property, not an afterthought.
